INCIDENT: API-2024-045 - Payment Processing Outage
DATE: August 12, 2024

- TechStart (99.9%): 52 min used of 43.2 min budget = 120% of budget = SLA BREACH

FINANCIAL IMPACT

- Acme Corp: 10% of monthly fee ($10,000) = $1,000 credit
- Global Industries: 15% of monthly fee ($25,000) = $3,750 credit
- TechStart: 10% of monthly fee ($15,000) = $1,500 credit
Total service credits due: $6,250

- Acme Corp: Notified at 14:30 UTC, acknowledged at 14:35 UTC

- TechStart: Notified at 14:35 UTC, acknowledged at 14:40 UTC

1. Immediate: Deploy connection pool monitoring (by Aug 15)

CONTRACTUAL NEXT STEPS
- Issue service credit invoices by August 20
- Schedule SLA review meetings with each client (by August 25)
- Update runbooks and incident response procedures (by September 15)
